title: The NORTH-WEST-GERMAN-STATE-LOTTERY offers an exciting opportunity for participants to win substantial prizes in German Marks (DM). With a total of 400,000 tickets available and over 147,000 prizes worth more than 133 million DM, players have a chance to win jackpots ranging from 100,000 to 1 million DM. The lottery runs in classes over six months, with public drawings supervised by state auditors, ensuring transparency and security. Participants can remain anonymous, and winnings are guaranteed by the German government. Tickets can be ordered easily, and winners are notified promptly. This lottery presents a unique chance to become a millionaire, with a favorable winning ratio of 1 in 3.
